task: Find the way to give a gift to UM-Dearborn.
agent_final_answer: The way to give a gift to UM-Dearborn from umich.edu: 1) Click "Giving" in the top navigation bar. 2) On the Giving page, click "Make a Gift to U-M" (this opens the Michigan Giving site, giving.umich.edu). 3) Click "Make a Gift" in the navigation. 4) In the "Search and Filter" sidebar, under the "Around our Campuses" section, check the "UM-Dearborn" box. This filters the funds to UM-Dearborn options (e.g., "Fund for UM-Dearborn - 301955", "UM-Dearborn Athletics Annual Fund", "UM-Dearborn CASL Annual Fund"). 5) Click the yellow "Give Now" button on the desired fund. This adds the fund to a Giving Basket and starts the donation checkout (Basket -> Gift Options -> Contact Info -> Review), where you choose a Monthly or One-time amount and complete payment.
